'''Asora's Sweet Surprise''' was a shop in [[Hedrett]], on [[Cularin/Legends|Cularin]].

==History==
Asora's Sweet Surprise was operated by the [[Farghul/Legends|Farghul]] [[Asora]] during the waning [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. It specialized in selling cake-baking ingredients, such as [[Toydarian yeast]]. Just prior to the [[Marriage/Legends|wedding]] of [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Lavina Durada-Vashne Wren|Lavina Wren]], a group of [[Devaronian/Legends|Devaronians]] came to the shop to purchase some ingredients, with which to bake a [[Poison/Legends|poisoned]] wedding cake.
